name: Blair
desc:
👻 Blair is a Phasmophobia inspired ghost hunting experience focused on gathering evidence, identifying several different types of ghosts, ranging from Demons to Spirits,  and exploring various haunted locations, known for having an incredible amount of paranormal activity. Are you brave enough to become Blair Inc.'s next Ghost Whisperer?

⚠️ This is a Paranormal Investigation game, expect elements of horror, flashing lights, and fear.
📱 Console and Mobile friendly!
🎧 Headphones & Max Graphics highly recommended!
🎙️ VC Radio & VC Only lobbies!
